newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Centaur sees 5 mln oz gold resource.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Centaur sees 5 mln oz gold resource.

text.p: MELBOURNE, Oct 25 (Retuer) - Centaur Mining and exploraiton Ltd expressed confidence on Friday that it had a major gold resource of at least five million ounces in mining tenements it holds northwest of Kalgoorlie, in Western Australia.
Chief executive Joseph Gutnick said Thursday's announcement of a major gold discovery at its Quarters tenement was likely to be the first significant new discoveries in the region.

Asked by reporters after the annual general meeting, if he was confident the area was a major gold province, Gutnick said: "I am very confident of five million oucnes. I think we will see that very quickly."

Centaur shareholders were told the company aimed to dramatically boost gold production at its Mt Pleasant and Ora Banda projects over the next two years to the point where each was producing around 300,000 ounces annually.

"We see gold production at Mt Pleasant going rapidly to 200,000 ounces a year and Ora Banda to 100,000, and within two years they will both be running at around 300,000 ounces a year," said director Eduard Eshuys.

Eshuys said that with Great Central Mines NL gold production forecast to reach around 700,000 ounces a year within 18 months, the two companies would exceed total production of one million ounces within two years.
Centaur, which bought the Ora Banda project from Newcrest Mining Ltd last August, believes the area is highly prospective, Eshuys said.
"We see the potential at Mt Pleasant has already been demonstrated to do 300,000 ounces. We see similar potential at Ora Banda," Eshuys said.
